notes.title: Improvement Plan
notes.notes:
[p]The Steam Automation Festival is ending, and thanks to you, we have gathered a ton of valuable feedback! 

We will be taking some time to carefully review everything and focus on refining the core gameplay loop based on your insights. This means[b] improvements to the overall experience[/b] will take priority over quick bug fixes for now, so we appreciate your patience as we dig in. 

Thank you for being part of this journey.
Your support truly means the world to us.[/p]
